name: Olvena (Spain)
description: Blue field with a broad yellow horizontal stripe edged red bulging into a disc at the centre, with a blue chevron pointing to the fly at the hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Olvena; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad horizontal stripe edged red, widening into a disc at the centre
chevron on the stripe pointing to the fly
